archetypes.name: dyn-difficulty-records
archetypes.rationale: Difficulty rating touches design, implement, review, and run-log paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new difficulty rating flow across bootstrap, preflight, manifest validation, and run-log writes. Check that missing or malformed ratings fail only on intended paths and that run-level records cannot overwrite nested review ownership. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
